items.title_en: DeepSeek Partners With Huawei on Ascend Programming Tools and Open-Source Infrastructure to Cut NVIDIA Reliance
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek与华为合作开发昇腾编程工具开源软件基础设施以减少对NVIDIA的依赖- AI 人工智能 cnBeta.COM
items.summary_en: DeepSeek is reportedly working with Huawei to develop programming tools for Huawei's Ascend chips and to build out related open-source software infrastructure, aiming to reduce reliance on NVIDIA. No technical details, timeline, or scope were disclosed in the report.
items.why_zh: 这反映出在算力受限背景下，中国 AI 公司正试图通过软硬件生态自建来摆脱对 NVIDIA 的依赖。
items.why_en: It highlights how Chinese AI firms are trying to escape dependence on NVIDIA by building their own hardware and software ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 戴森 AI 电动牙刷 CamaraJet 一度“下架”，官方承认早期批次产品存在渗水故障
items.title_en: Dyson Admits Water-Leak Defect in Early CameraJet AI Toothbrush Batch After Brief Retail Pullback
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，据彭博社今天（30 日）报道，戴森确认，新推出的 CameraJet 可视成像牙刷早期一个批次因渗水发生故障。 这也是戴森首次说明 CameraJet 为何一度从零售渠道消失 。CameraJet 售价 499 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,352 元人民币） ，通过 AI 和内置摄像头实时提供刷牙反馈。名称中的“Jet”来自牙刷喷出的漱口水水流，水流会对准牙菌斑，起到类似牙线的清洁作用。上市后不久，陆续有消费者在社交媒体上反映产品故障，有些牙刷甚至使用几分钟便突然停止工作。 戴森提供的声明称，一个批次的喷射管在生产环节出现问题，存在渗水风险，影响了少量产品的性能。出现故障后，喷射管内的水可能 漏进牙刷其他部位 。 戴森随后将受影响的库存单独隔离，CameraJet 因此一度断货。发言人称，目前 CameraJet 已全面投产，并开始向合作伙伴供货。 作为戴森历时多年研发的首款牙刷，CameraJet 原本承载着一次重要的新品发布。但 9 月 1 日上市后不久，百思买等大型零售商便从官网撤下了这款产品。 一名了解情况的人士称，戴森内部部分员工对事件的处理方式感到不满。CameraJet 发布当天，一些戴森管理人员很快在社交媒体上称赞这一项目，但消费者开始要求戴森作出解释后，这些人便不再发声。 最新声明中，戴森发言人向买到故障产品的消费者致歉：“…
items.summary_en: Dyson confirmed that an early batch of its $499 CameraJet AI toothbrush had a production defect in the jet tube that could let water leak into other parts of the device, prompting a brief removal from retail channels such as Best Buy. Dyson says affected inventory was quarantined and the product is now in full production, and it apologized to customers who received faulty units.
items.why_zh: 这是戴森首次公开解释其首款牙刷新品为何一度从零售渠道消失，也显示 AI 硬件新品在量产良率与品控上的风险。
items.why_en: It is Dyson's first explanation of why its debut toothbrush vanished from shelves, illustrating production-quality risks for new AI hardware.

items.title_zh: 豆包上线一句话订机票、火车票、打车导航功能
items.title_en: Doubao Adds One-Sentence Booking for Flights, Train Tickets, Rides and Navigation
items.summary_zh: 豆包上线一句话订机票、火车票、打车导航功能 搜狐网
items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao has rolled out a feature letting users book flights and train tickets and hail rides or start navigation with a single sentence. The report did not specify which ticketing, airline, or ride-hailing partners are supported.
items.why_zh: AI 助手正从“聊天问答”走向直接调用交易与服务，出行是智能体落地的高频场景。
items.why_en: It shows AI assistants moving from chat to directly executing transactions and services, with travel a high-frequency agent use case.

items.title_zh: Meta Muse 爆火，美银警示 AI 智能体或冲击苹果服务业务收入
items.title_en: Meta's Muse Surges as BofA Warns AI Agents Could Hit Apple's Services Revenue
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，美国银行于今日发布了一份新的投资者研报，指出 Meta 推出的全新 Muse 人工智能智能体表明，第三方 AI 智能体有可能会越来越多地绕开苹果生态体系，进而威胁苹果的服务业务收入。 在美国银行分析师瓦姆西 · 莫汉（Wamsi Mohan）发布投资者研报，警示 Meta 的 Muse 这类 AI 智能体有可能逐步接管原本由苹果生态完成的商品发现、服务导流以及交易发起之后，苹果的股价今日跌幅超过 2.5%。 这份研报内容写道：“苹果面临的风险在于，即便它依旧可以保住每一台手机的销量，却仍然有可能失去商品发现、导流以及交易发起这部分业务。” 莫汉发布这份研报之际，Meta 的 Muse 已经在美国应用商店免费应用榜单上连续两周位居榜首。据 Sensor Tower 的估算数据，截至上周，Muse 的累计下载量已经超过 340 万次。 这款类似 OpenClaw 的 Meta AI 智能体可以浏览网页、填写表单、预订行程、发送邮件，并且代表用户完成购物。其已经迅速收获普通大众的欢迎，仅用时十天就超越 ChatGPT，登上美国应用商店榜单首位。 再回到莫汉的这份研报，他维持苹果的“买入”评级，给出 370 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,486 元人民币） 的目标股价。他认为，尽管 AI 智能体带来了新的风险，但他依旧相信苹果最终将会成为“端侧人工智能…
items.summary_en: Bank of America warned that Meta's fast-growing Muse AI agent, which can browse, book, email, and shop on users' behalf, could let third-party agents bypass Apple's ecosystem and erode its services revenue, sending Apple shares down more than 2.5%. Muse has topped the U.S. App Store free chart for two weeks with over 3.4 million downloads, per Sensor Tower.
items.why_zh: 它点出了 AI 智能体可能重构流量入口与交易发起权，从而动摇苹果服务收入的护城河。
items.why_en: It flags how AI agents could reshape discovery and transaction entry points, threatening Apple's services moat.

items.title_zh: 豆包上线“出行用豆包”专属入口：一站式搞定订票、打车、导航全流程
items.title_en: Doubao Launches Dedicated 'Travel with Doubao' Entry for Booking, Rides and Navigation
items.summary_zh: 豆包上线“出行用豆包”专属入口：一站式搞定订票、打车、导航全流程 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Doubao has introduced a dedicated 'Travel with Doubao' entry point that consolidates ticket booking, ride-hailing, and navigation into a single flow. Details on partners, regional coverage, and pricing were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 专属入口表明 AI 助手正把出行服务整合为完整的任务闭环，强化用户黏性。
items.why_en: The dedicated hub shows AI assistants packaging travel into a complete task loop to boost user retention.

items.title_zh: “美国散户大本营”Robinhood 推出 AI 智能体工具，可自动替用户盯盘交易
items.title_en: Robinhood Launches AI Agent Tools That Watch Markets and Trade for Users
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，“美国散户大本营”线上券商 Robinhood 当地时间周二于休斯敦乔治 ·R· 布朗会议中心举办年度活动，高管团队集中揭晓了一系列重磅新工具与服务。 其中最引人注目的是一款应用内人工智能助手 ——Robinhood Agents，它不仅能解答行情疑问、从零搭建定制化投资策略， 并最终能在你入睡、工作或远离屏幕时，自动替你盯盘并执行交易。 Robinhood 首席执行官 Vlad Tenev 表示，这类所谓的智能体交易工具，将把以往对冲基金及华尔街专业机构专属的高阶操盘能力，真正普及给普通散户。 此外，Robinhood 还将上线多款新产品，其中包括加密货币永续期货合约、财报挂钩期权，同时还计划推出周末股票交易服务。 IT之家注意到，早在今年五月，Robinhood 就已经在交易平台中接入人工智能功能，允许用户将外部 AI 智能体连接至这家线上券商的交易底层系统。该公司称，自那时起大约已有 15 万名用户开设过智能体交易账户。 这一次更新的版本把整套操作体验整合进 Robinhood Markets 自身的应用内部，以此降低使用上的阻碍。 用户可以下达指令，让 AI 智能体监控市场并执行交易，其中也包括依照预设条件运行的重复交易策略。 系统默认开启逐笔交易确认机制，不过用户可以手动关闭确认权限，允许 AI 智能体自主开展交易。AI 智能体只能动用转入…
items.summary_en: Robinhood unveiled Robinhood Agents, an in-app AI assistant that builds custom strategies and can automatically monitor markets and execute trades while users are away. It also plans crypto perpetual futures, earnings-linked options, and weekend stock trading; about 150,000 users have already opened agent trading accounts since May.
items.why_zh: 把机构级自动化交易能力开放给散户，同时把“是否放手让 AI 自主下单”的权限问题推向前台。
items.why_en: It brings institutional-grade automated trading to retail investors and foregrounds the question of how much autonomy to grant AI.

items.title_zh: 经验时代的自我发现式强化学习：学习历史是资产还是负担？
items.title_en: Self-discovering RL in the Era of Experience: Is Learning History an Asset or a Burden?
items.summary_zh: arXiv 新论文探讨在通向通用智能的递归自我改进（RSI）路径中，宏观层面的语言模型规模化与“经验时代”（Era of Experience）所强调的交互驱动原则之间的分野。作者指出，任何自我改进架构最终都依赖其底层优化引擎：若通用智能需要从有依据的交互中学习，那么强化学习的更新规则本身也必须具备累积适应能力。论文提到算法自我发现已产出 Disco103，其在基准性能上超越了 PPO 并达到 SOTA，并进一步追问“学习历史”究竟是资产还是负担。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35897v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pursuit of recursive self-improvement (RSI) toward general intelligence is divided between macro-level language model scaling and the interaction-driven principles of "Era of Experience". Yet, any self-improving architecture ultimately rests upon its underlying optimization engine: if general intelligence requires learning from grounded interaction, the reinforcement learning (RL) update rule itself must be capable of cumulative adaptation. While algorithm self-discovery has produced Disco103 that surpassed PPO to achieve SOTA benchmark perfo…
items.why_zh: 如果 RL 更新规则本身能随经验积累演化，自我改进型智能体的能力上限与路径可能被重新定义。
items.why_en: If the RL update rule itself can evolve with experience, the ceiling and trajectory of self-improving agents could be redefined.

items.title_zh: V-Engram：面向模块化文生图个性化的触发索引外部记忆机制
items.title_en: V-Engram: Trigger-Indexed External Memory for Modular Text-to-Image Personalization
items.summary_zh: arXiv 新论文提出 V-Engram，一种面向 Stable Diffusion 3.5 的触发索引外部记忆机制，用于模块化的文生图个性化。作者指出，预训练文生图模型虽具备广泛的视觉知识，却难以仅凭少量参考图可靠地习得或精修某一特定视觉身份，同时保持构图控制能力：基于 token 嵌入的方法紧凑但常对身份拟合不足，而基于适配器的方法虽通过持久化权重更新提升保真度，却存储成本高，且在概念组合时容易相互干扰。V-Engram 为每个概念分配一个显式触发器，将身份信息存入外部记忆，以在保真度与组合控制之间取得平衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained text-to-image models contain broad visual knowledge, yet they cannot reliably acquire or refine a specific visual identity from only a few references while preserving compositional control. Token-embedding methods are compact but often underfit identity, whereas adapter-based methods improve fidelity through persistent weight updates that can be costly to store and interfere when concepts are composed. We introduce V-Engram, a trigger-indexed external memory mechanism for Stable Diffusion 3.5. Each concept is assigned an explicit trigg…
items.why_zh: 它为“少样本保持身份又不干扰其他概念”的个性化生成难题提供了一条外置记忆的解决思路。
items.why_en: It offers an external-memory approach to few-shot identity personalization without sacrificing compositional control.

items.title_zh: 上下文语言模型（CLM）：让模型把上下文当作文件自主管理
items.title_en: Context Language Models
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 Context Language Models（CLM），即原生地管理自身上下文的语言模型。其实现方式是把上下文视为一个文件，允许模型对该文件进行不受限制的更新，从而让模型自行学习哪些内容最值得保留在上下文中；这一机制还能自然扩展到多智能体系统，多个智能体的上下文作为并列文件共存。作者用现有模型以零样本方式构建 CLM，在多种任务上优于当前最先进的上下文管理策略：准确率高出 11.4%，同时 FLOPs 减少 21.5%。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOP…
items.why_zh: 它把上下文管理从外部策略变成模型自身可学习的能力，可能改变长上下文与多智能体系统的设计方式。
items.why_en: It turns context management from an external heuristic into a capability the model itself learns, potentially reshaping long-context and multi-agent system design.

items.title_zh: 诊断并改进大语言模型的概率推理能力
items.title_en: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 研究关注 LLM 作为决策助手时必须具备的概率推理能力，提出一个决策论框架，将模型的决策损失分解为两个部分：一是依据所给证据形成准确的信念，二是把信念转化为能够优化给定效用函数的行动。作者使用真实答案已知的合成基准，将这一分解应用于前沿模型与开源模型，以刻画它们在概率推理上的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced mod…
items.why_zh: 把“信念不准”与“决策不当”区分开，有助于更精确地定位 LLM 作为决策助手时的短板。
items.why_en: Separating flawed beliefs from flawed decisions helps pinpoint exactly where LLMs fall short as decision assistants.

items.title_zh: 为测试时 AI4AI 的智能体外壳设计学习元技能
items.title_en: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
items.summary_zh: 论文研究测试时的 AI-for-AI：在 Builder 与 Target 两个模型的权重都保持固定的前提下，Builder 如何为 Target 构建更好的执行环境。为使 Builder 的经验可复用，作者提出 Meta-Skill，即规定“何时需要支持、应提供什么资源”的原则；Builder 从 Target 在开发集上的执行反馈中学习这些原则，再利用冻结的技能库为未见过的任务构建执行外壳（harness）。研究强调，智能体的表现既取决于推理能力，也取决于其所处的环境。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38143v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen t…
items.why_zh: 它表明智能体性能不只由模型本身决定，执行环境的构建本身也可以被学习并复用。
items.why_en: It shows agent performance depends on the harness as much as the model, and that harness design can itself be learned and reused.

items.title_zh: 多模态大模型能否生成并检测社交媒体多模态假新闻？
items.title_en: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?
items.summary_zh: 生成式 AI 的快速进步引发担忧：多模态大模型（MLLM）可能被用于在社交媒体上发动大规模虚假信息活动。尽管已有针对文本虚假信息的研究，一个基本问题仍未得到回答：MLLM 能否被利用来捏造逼真的多模态假新闻，又能否可靠地检测出这类内容？作者提出一个多智能体框架，由故事智能体、图像智能体和评论（critic）智能体协作，生成看起来可信、能够与真实新闻相抗衡的虚假社交帖子，并据此展开实验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35809v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framew…
items.why_zh: 同一类模型既能造谣也可能用于检测，弄清这两种能力对平台治理与内容审核至关重要。
items.why_en: If the same models can both create and catch multimodal fake news, understanding both capabilities is essential for platform governance and moderation.

items.title_zh: 超越关键词：用生成式 LLM 与标签聚合分类新闻中的经济政策不确定性
items.title_en: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
items.summary_zh: 该研究把大语言模型用于公共部门的经济监测，自动判断一篇文章是否涉及经济政策不确定性（EPU）并识别其具体类型。以往研究要么依赖关键词，容易产生大量误报；要么采用机器学习方法，需要大量高质量人工标注数据，获取成本高、耗时长。本文提出基于弱监督技术的方法，并结合标签聚合来提升分类效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35856v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques…
items.why_zh: 它为政府经济监测提供了一条比关键词更准确、比人工标注更省成本的自动化路径。
items.why_en: It offers a more accurate and cheaper automated path to economic monitoring than keyword rules or heavy human labeling.

items.title_zh: 先学、即用、后信：面向 LLM 智能体的序贯式测试时学习
items.title_en: Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 在部署过程中适配大语言模型智能体，不仅要保留过往经验，还要把新的观察及时转化为可用指导。然而许多测试时学习方法是从已完成的回合（episode）中获取知识，正在进行的交互所产生的反馈往往来不及被提炼成知识，无法帮助下一次决策。以单次状态转移（transition）为粒度获取知识可以缩短这一延迟，但也带来另一个问题：在某一个回合内有效的规则，未必足够可靠、能够跨情境沿用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35911v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable eno…
items.why_zh: 它直指测试时学习的关键矛盾：知识更新速度与跨情境可靠性之间的取舍。
items.why_en: It targets a core tension in test-time learning: how fast knowledge updates versus how trustworthy it remains.

items.title_zh: 在策略视觉证据蒸馏
items.title_en: On-Policy Visual Evidence Distillation
items.summary_zh: 视觉智能体通过推理与图像操作的交替来解决问题，而在策略蒸馏（OPD）可以让强教师模型对学生生成的交互轨迹提供指导。但图像操作会改变后续推理可用的证据，因此证据获取（Acquire）、读取（Read）或答案落地（Ground）环节的局部错误会沿轨迹传播，最终导致答案出错。现有的多模态 OPD 方法主要围绕原图构建或对比辅助视图来应对这一问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.36838v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visual agents solve problems by interleaving reasoning with image operations, and on-policy distillation (OPD) provides guidance from a strong teacher on student-generated interaction trajectories. However, image operations change the evidence available for subsequent reasoning, so local errors in evidence acquisition (Acquire), reading (Read), or answer grounding (Ground) can propagate through the trajectory and lead to incorrect answers. Existing multimodal OPD methods primarily construct or contrast auxiliary views of the original image to s…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了多模态蒸馏中误差沿轨迹传播的路径，为改进视觉智能体训练提供诊断视角。
items.why_en: It reveals how errors propagate along multimodal distillation trajectories, offering a diagnostic angle for improving visual agent training.

items.title_zh: 超越压缩：诊断后训练如何改变数学推理
items.title_en: Beyond Compression: Diagnosing How Post-Training Changes Mathematical Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 后训练是现代大语言模型数学推理能力的核心，但仅看终点的 pass@1 指标无法说明究竟发生了什么变化——性能提升可能来自新可达的解、对潜在解更高效的采样、表层鲁棒性，或是记忆。作者在统一的诊断读出下比较三条后训练路径：其自身充分训练的离策略蒸馏轨迹、已开源的 Qwen3 离策略加在策略蒸馏端点，以及以组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练的已开源 DeepSeek-Math 端点。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37066v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-training is central to mathematical reasoning in modern large language models (LLMs), but endpoint pass@1 alone underidentifies what has changed. Gains may reflect newly reachable solutions, cheaper sampling of latent solutions, surface robustness, or memorisation. We compare three post-training paths under a common diagnostic readout: our sufficiently trained off-policy distillation trajectories, released Qwen3 off-policy-plus-on-policy distillation endpoints, and a released DeepSeek-Math endpoint trained with Group Relative Policy Optimi…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者在评估后训练效果时不能只看准确率，而要区分能力提升的不同来源。
items.why_en: It warns that accuracy alone cannot tell whether post-training added real capability or merely memorisation and sampling efficiency.

items.title_zh: 多声道音频质量评估：将预训练感知模型扩展到空间音频
items.title_en: Multichannel Audio Quality Assessment: Extending Pretrained Perceptual Models to Spatial Audio
items.summary_zh: 空间音频的感知质量不仅取决于信号保真度，还取决于声道间的空间关系，因此精准的感知质量评估对评估与优化空间音频至关重要。但主观评测成本高昂，而现有感知模型多针对有限的声道配置训练，无法直接用于更高声道数的音频。该研究提出一个核心问题：如何有效复用预训练的感知知识来处理多声道空间音频？作者以 5.1 声道音频为对象，系统研究了四个层级的迁移与适配方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37116v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate perceptual quality assessment is essential for evaluating and optimizing spatial audio, where perceived quality depends on both signal fidelity and inter-channel spatial relationships. However, subjective evaluation is costly, while existing perceptual models are often trained for limited channel configurations and cannot be directly applied to higher-channel-count audio. This raises the question: how can pretrained perceptual knowledge be effectively reused for multichannel spatial audio? Using 5.1-channel audio, we study four levels…
items.why_zh: 为把成熟的音频感知模型迁移到空间音频提供可行路径，有望降低沉浸式音频的评测成本。
items.why_en: It offers a path to reuse mature perceptual audio models for spatial audio, potentially lowering the cost of evaluating immersive audio.

items.title_zh: 把学习问题编译成语言模型的适配程序
items.title_en: Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models
items.summary_zh: 模型适配通常沿用固定配方，但不同的更新程序会带来明显不同的行为结果。作者提出“适配编译”（adaptation compilation），把“模型应在何处、以何种方式、在多大程度上适配”重构为联合预测与决策问题。与其为每个学习任务重新搜索候选程序，编译器从以往的适配经验中学习，预测候选程序上的向量值反事实响应面，即它们对获取、迁移等目标的预期效果，从而直接为当前任务选择适配方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37371v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transf…
items.why_zh: 用学习与预测替代逐任务搜索，可能让模型适配更高效、更具可迁移性。
items.why_en: Replacing per-task search with learned prediction could make model adaptation more efficient and transferable.

items.title_zh: 工程化高效自对弈国际象棋：有限算力下的搜索、回放与吞吐
items.title_en: Engineering Efficient Self-Play Chess: Search, Replay, and Throughput Under Limited Compute
items.summary_zh: 该工作探究在有限训练算力下，若将整个学习闭环都针对效率进行工程优化，AlphaZero 风格的国际象棋系统能达到多强。作者在单台八卡 GPU 节点上，从随机初始化开始经过带搜索的自对弈训练 2.5 天，得到 632 万参数模型，在对阵固定节点数的 Stockfish 13 阶梯测试中，每步 10 万次搜索（估计思考时间不到 5 秒）下达到 3251 基准 Elo（置信区间 3206–3297）。整个训练过程摄入 325 万个完整对局，估计包含约 1000 亿次搜索模拟。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37447v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How strong can an AlphaZero-style chess system become under limited training compute when its entire learning loop is engineered for efficiency? We train from random initialization through searched self-play on a single eight-GPU node for 2.5 days. The resulting 6.32-million-parameter model reaches 3,251 benchmark Elo [3,206, 3,297] at 100,000 searches per move (estimated at under five seconds of thinking time) against a fixed-node Stockfish 13 ladder. The run ingests 3.25 million completed games, involves an estimated 100 billion search simula…
items.why_zh: 表明通过系统级工程优化，中小规模算力也能训练出接近顶尖水平的自对弈棋类模型。
items.why_en: It shows that careful system engineering lets modest compute produce near-top-level self-play game models.

items.title_zh: AgentBug-Smith：自动复现智能体系统中的真实 Harness 缺陷
items.title_en: AgentBug-Smith: Automatically Reproducing Real-World Harness Bugs in Agentic Systems
items.summary_zh: 智能体框架（harness）中的缺陷具有独特特征，即便是当前最先进的软件智能体也难以修复。该方向进展受阻还因为现有基准只包含少量固定的可执行 harness 缺陷，且构建一条往往需要数百人工小时。为此，作者提出 AgentBug-Smith，一种自动化的 harness 缺陷复现方法，能持续从开源智能体系统中发现并复现真实缺陷；在不同骨干大模型上，该方法均表现出一致的复现能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37864v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agent harness bugs exhibit unique characteristics and remain challenging for state-of-the-art software agents to repair. Progress in this area is further hindered by existing benchmarks, which contain only a small and fixed number of executable harness bugs while requiring hundreds of human hours to construct. This work presents AgentBug-Smith, an automated harness bug reproduction approach that continuously discovers and reproduces real-world harness bugs from open-source agentic systems. Across different backbone LLMs, AgentBug-Smith consiste…
items.why_zh: 把缺陷复现从人工重成本劳动变为可持续的自动化流程，为提升智能体可靠性提供数据来源。
items.why_en: It turns bug reproduction from costly manual labor into a continuous automated pipeline that can feed agent-reliability work.

items.title_zh: BITEM 在 NTCIR-19 R2C2 任务：从智能体式 RAG 流程信号预测置信度
items.title_en: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
items.summary_zh: BITEM 团队用一个统一的智能体式流程参加了 NTCIR-19 R2C2 的两个子任务：模型在电影语料上搜索、阅读并记录证据，由编排器保存记录并裁定哪些内容可以提交。一条论断只有在蕴涵级联校验通过、与所引用段落相符后才会被采纳，只有当足够多经过校验的证据支撑时才会给出答案。每个问题会运行三到四次，每次检索所用的语料都已剔除此前轮次已看过的内容。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37993v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen…
items.why_zh: 展示了以证据校验与多轮检索为核心的流程如何为 RAG 答案提供可解释的置信度信号。
items.why_en: It shows how evidence-verification and multi-pass retrieval can yield interpretable confidence signals for RAG answers.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型中的性别偏见普遍存在且高度异质
items.title_en: Gender bias across LLMs is common and highly heterogenous
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型被嵌入到会产生真实后果的决策支持工具中，理解其性别偏见日益重要。以往研究只覆盖少数模型，无法说明性别偏见在大模型间究竟有多普遍、差异有多大。该研究涵盖 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 6 月间发布的、来自九家厂商的十款模型，采用两种范式：将性别归因于刻板印象化短语（研究一），以及对针对女性的虐待或折磨作道德判断（研究二）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38036v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding gender biases in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important as these systems become embedded in decision-support tools with real consequences. Prior research has focused only on a small set of models, leaving open the extent to which gender biases are common and heterogeneous across LLMs. We address this gap across ten models released between April 2025 and June 2026, spanning nine vendors, using two paradigms: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases (Study 1) and moral judgment of abuse or torture against a woman or…
items.why_zh: 跨厂商、跨模型的大规模对比揭示性别偏见普遍且高度异质，提示单一模型的评测结论难以外推。
items.why_en: A cross-vendor, multi-model comparison shows gender bias is pervasive yet highly heterogeneous, warning against extrapolating from single-model evaluations.

items.title_zh: BadRAG：揭示大语言模型检索增强生成中的安全漏洞
items.title_en: BadRAG: Identifying Vulnerabilities in Retrieval Augmented Generation of Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过从外部知识库检索相关信息，让大语言模型给出更准确、更有上下文依据且更新的回答。但这种对外部知识的依赖也带来显著安全风险：许多 RAG 系统（如 Google Search）依赖庞大且未经清洗的数据仓库（如 Reddit）。本文揭示了一种新型威胁——攻击者通过向知识库注入恶意段落来操控 RAG 系统的回答。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2406.00083v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases to provide more accurate, contextually informed, and up-to-date responses. However, this reliance on external knowledge introduces significant security vulnerabilities, as many RAG systems (e.g., Google Search) rely on large and unsanitized data repositories (e.g., Reddit). In this paper, we unveil a novel threat in which attackers steer the RAG system's response by injecting malicious passages into…
items.why_zh: 指出 RAG 的外部知识源可被投毒并直接操纵输出，是部署检索增强系统时必须正视的安全问题。
items.why_en: It shows that RAG's external knowledge sources can be poisoned to steer outputs, a key security concern for deployed retrieval-augmented systems.

items.title_zh: PRISM：将漂移分解为尺度、形状与预测头的几何风险界
items.title_en: PRISM: A Geometric Risk Bound for Decomposing Drift into Scale, Shape, and Head
items.summary_zh: 如今一个基座大模型往往衍生出数十个后训练变体，包括量化、LoRA 适配或蒸馏版本，每一个在发布前都需要检查。现有评估只给出局部图景：基准分数与似然筛查只能说明变体是否退化，CKA、SVCCA 等相似度指标只能说明特征如何移动，二者之间缺少联系。作者通过一个结构事实与一个设计选择把它们连起来：预测头是线性的，因此特征几何会影响损失，进而可以对比两组特征。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.11608v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A single base LLM now comes with dozens of post-training variants, quantized, LoRA-adapted, or distilled, and each has to be checked before release. Existing evaluations provide only a partial picture: benchmark scores and likelihood screens say that a variant has degraded, similarity scores such as CKA and SVCCA say how its features moved, and nothing connects the two. We connect them with one structural fact and one design choice: the prediction head is linear, so feature geometry reaches the loss, and we compare the two feature sets…
items.why_zh: 为模型变体的发布前评估提供统一的风险量化框架，把基准分数与特征相似度纳入同一解释体系。
items.why_en: It offers a unified risk-quantification framework that ties benchmark scores and feature-similarity measures together for pre-release model checks.

items.title_zh: 随机极小极大树的双保真度最优动作识别
items.title_en: Two-Fidelity Best-Action Identification for Stochastic Minimax Tree
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究随机极小极大树中的固定置信度最优动作识别（BAI）问题。其背景是现代 AI 规划中，深度极小极大搜索与结合语言模型长 rollout 的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）面临一个根本权衡：启发式评估廉价但有偏差，精确 rollout 可靠却代价高昂。作者提出 2FFS——一种把多保真度“平坦老虎机”思想引入树结构的双保真度树搜索算法，通过极小极大式的快速扩展等方式，在效率与准确性之间取得平衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.01708v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study fixed-confidence best-action identification (BAI) in stochastic minimax trees. This problem is increasingly relevant in modern AI planning, where deep minimax search and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with language model long rollouts face a fundamental tradeoff: heuristic evaluations are cheap but biased, while accurate rollouts are reliable but prohibitively expensive. We propose 2FFS, a two-fidelity tree-search algorithm that brings multi-fidelity flat bandit ideas into trees. The algorithm combines minimax-style fast expans…
items.why_zh: 它为算力受限下的规划搜索提供了在廉价近似与昂贵精确评估之间取平衡的新思路。
items.why_en: It offers a principled way to balance cheap approximations against expensive accurate evaluations in planning search.

items.title_zh: Active-SWE：评测编程智能体在没有 issue 报告时的主动修 bug 能力
items.title_en: Active-SWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Proactive Bug Fixing without Issue Reports
items.summary_zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的编程智能体正越来越多地被用于软件工程场景，能够在大规模代码库中修复特定缺陷。但现有 SWE 基准通常假设总能获得信息详尽的高质量 issue 报告，而由于报告获取与整理的复杂性，这一假设在现实中往往不成立。为此作者提出 Active-SWE，一个用于评估编程智能体在缺少 issue 报告的情况下主动发现并修复多个 bug 的基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.04682v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in software engineering (SWE) scenarios, capable of fixing a specific bug in large-scale codebase. However, existing SWE benchmarks typically assume that high-quality issue reports with detailed information are always available, which is easily violated in practice due to the complexity of report acquisition and curation. To address this, we introduce Active-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on proactively discovering and fixing multiple bugs with…
items.why_zh: 它针对一个更贴近现实、却被现有基准忽视的场景：智能体必须在没有整理好的 issue 报告时自行定位缺陷。
items.why_en: It targets a realistic but under-benchmarked setting where agents must find bugs without curated issue reports.

items.title_zh: 替换的错觉：基础模型时代重新审视专用机器学习模型
items.title_en: The Illusion of Replacement: Rethinking Specialized Machine Learning Models in the Foundation Model Era
items.summary_zh: 专用机器学习架构内嵌了等变性、置换不变性、关系结构等结构性假设，而基于语言的基础模型在设计上并不具备这些假设。这篇综述基于 2016 至 2026 年间、横跨表格数据、图、时间序列、视觉、化学、代码、知识图谱、点云与蛋白质结构九种模态的 186 篇论文，追问这些假设能否改由语言习得，并把相关方法归纳为八种表征范式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28980v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Specialized machine learning architectures encode structural assumptions (equivariance, permutation invariance, relational structure) that language-based foundation models lack by design. This review asks whether such assumptions can instead be acquired through language, drawing on a corpus of 186 papers published between 2016 and 2026 across nine modalities: tabular data, graphs, time series, vision, chemistry, code, knowledge graphs, point clouds, and protein structure. Methods are organized into eight representational regimes, rangin…
items.why_zh: 它直接叩问基础模型能否取代专用架构，以及结构性先验是否可以从语言中学到。
items.why_en: It asks whether the structural priors built into specialized models can be learned from language instead.

items.title_zh: 面向开源游戏发布事故预测的类型化时间交互特征
items.title_en: Typed Temporal Interaction Features for Simulation-Backed Forecasting of Open-Source Game Release Incidents
items.summary_zh: 开源电子游戏的质量取决于代码、素材、配置、测试、贡献者与 issue 工作流之间的交互，而传统缺陷预测器往往把这些关系扁平化甚至忽略。作者研究如何在发布层面预测 30 天内出现的质量事故，提出 GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot：一个类型化时间特征流水线，配有校准的风险估计与考虑工作量的排序。由于可获取的 OS-SGameBench 材料未提供人工核验的发布日期与故障标签，实际执行的评估受到限制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open-source video-game quality depends on inter-actions among code, assets, configuration, tests, contributors, and issue workflows, yet conventional defect predictors usually flatten or omit these relations. We investigate release-level forecasting of a quality incident within thirty days using GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot, a typed temporal feature pipeline with calibrated risk estimates and effort-aware ranking. Because the accessible OS-SGameBench materials do not provide manually audited release dates and outbreak labels, the executed evaluation is ex…
items.why_zh: 它把游戏质量预测从单一代码指标转向代码、素材与协作流程之间的类型化时间关系。
items.why_en: It reframes game quality prediction around typed temporal relations among code, assets, contributors, and issue workflows.

items.title_zh: 超越图模型：自适应元学习器融合可解释性、天气与动力学以稳健预测公交到站时间
items.title_en: Beyond the Graph: An Adaptive Meta-Learner Fuses Explainability, Weather, and Dynamics for Robust Bus ETA Prediction
items.summary_zh: 准确的公交到站时间（ETA）预测对城市出行、乘客满意度与公交运行效率至关重要，但现有模型难以应对非线性时空动态、数据稀疏以及天气等因素。论文提出 HYB(nm)，一个自适应混合集成框架，动态融合五种互补模型，包括历史基线 MST-AV、周期性时间模式分析 GDRN-DFT、刻画非线性动力学的 Koopman 神经算子 KOOP-NET，以及融合天气信息的特征工程神经网络等。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate bus Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is vital for urban mobility, passenger satisfaction, and transit efficiency, yet existing models falter against nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics, data sparsity, and factors such as weather. This paper proposes HYB(nm), an adaptive hybrid ensemble framework that dynamically fuses five complementary models - a historical baseline (MST-AV), periodical temporal pattern analysis (GDRN-DFT), Koopman Neural Operators for nonlinear dynamics (KOOP-NET), weather-integrated feature-engineered neural n…
items.why_zh: 它展示了如何通过自适应融合互补模型，让公交到站预测在天气与稀疏数据下依然稳健。
items.why_en: It shows how adaptively fusing complementary models can make transit ETA prediction robust to weather and sparse data.

items.title_zh: 基于超宽带雷达数据的人体活动识别：降维、模式发现与预测建模框架
items.title_en: Human Activity Recognition via Ultra-Wideband Data: A Framework for Dimensionality Reduction, Pattern Discovery, and Predictive Modeling
items.summary_zh: 传感器技术的进步推动了人体活动识别（HAR），尤其是在计算资源有限的实时系统中。但超宽带（UWB）雷达数据仍因高维、噪声、复杂性与非线性特征而难以处理。该研究提出一套框架，高效压缩数据规模、挖掘显著模式，并从 UWB 信号中高精度分类六种活动类型（Standff、Liedown、Noactivity、Sit、Stand、Walk），其中包含两种新颖的降维方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in sensor technology have enabled more effective human activity recognition (HAR), particularly in real-time systems with limited computational resources. However, Ultra-Wideband (UWB) radar data remain challenging due to high dimensionality, noise, complexity, and nonlinear characteristics. This research proposes a framework to efficiently reduce data size, uncover significant patterns, and classify six activity types (Standff, Liedown, Noactivity, Sit, Stand, and Walk) from UWB signals with high accuracy. Two novel dimensionalit…
items.why_zh: 它表明 UWB 雷达信号可以支撑高精度且资源高效的活动识别，为实时 HAR 提供可行路径。
items.why_en: It demonstrates that UWB radar signals can support accurate, resource-efficient activity recognition.

items.title_zh: SAMBAR：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的平衡知识获取与保持
items.title_en: SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型借助大规模预训练追求通用操作能力，而部署后的策略必须支持持续学习，以便随时间掌握新任务。教会 VLA 新任务通常需要在其演示数据上微调，但对下游任务的朴素微调会让策略遗忘早期任务并削弱通用能力，即所谓的灾难性遗忘。多数持续学习方法依靠回放旧任务数据来对抗遗忘，SAMBAR 则提出基于乘子法的选择性锚定，力求在新知识获取与旧知识保持之间取得平衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale pretraining to ultimately achieve generalist manipulation. Deployed VLA policies must support continual learning to acquire new tasks over time. Teaching a VLA a new task generally requires finetuning it on demonstrations of that task. However, naively finetuning on downstream tasks causes the policy to forget earlier tasks and degrades generalist capabilities. This failure is known as catastrophic forgetting. Most continual learning methods counter it by replaying data from earlier tasks.…
items.why_zh: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习型机器人策略落地的核心障碍，该工作提出了新的平衡方案。
items.why_en: Catastrophic forgetting is a central obstacle to deploying continually learning robot policies, and this work offers a new balancing approach.

items.title_zh: 旧评估何时能为新模型背书？评估器漂移下的标签高效发布决策
items.title_en: When Can Old Evaluations Certify a New Model? Label-Efficient Release Decisions under Evaluator Drift
items.summary_zh: 发布模型更新需要认证其当前人群风险低于某一阈值。可信标签成本高昂，而廉价评估器（如 LLM 判官）能为每个样本打分。复用早先审计中的评估器误差颇具吸引力，但这类证据何时可以替代当前标签，取决于历史状态：如果误差可能发生不可见的变化，就没有任何无标签检验能检出这种变化，任何有效且有用的认证器都必须按论文刻画的速率持续购买标签；如果假定误差变化有界，则可实现标签高效的认证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Releasing a model update requires certifying that its current-population risk stays below a threshold. Trusted labels are expensive, while a cheap evaluator, such as an LLM judge, scores every example. Reusing evaluator errors from earlier audits is tempting, but when may such evidence replace current labels? It depends on the status of history. If the errors can change invisibly, no label-free test detects the change, and every valid, useful certifier must keep buying labels at a rate we characterize; if a bound on the change is assumed, label-f…
items.why_zh: 它为模型发布决策中“旧评估证据能否替代昂贵新标签”给出了明确的理论边界。
items.why_en: It formalizes when stale evaluator evidence can substitute for expensive fresh labels in model release decisions.

items.title_zh: 协同信息何时有助于主动特征获取？一项基于 PID 的研究
items.title_en: When Does Synergy Help Active Feature Acquisition? A PID-Based Study
items.summary_zh: 主动特征获取（AFA）需要在预算约束下逐步挑选最有信息量的特征，但现有策略很少区分交互特征带来的信息究竟是冗余、独有还是协同的。作者提出 SynAFA——一种依赖状态的 AFA 策略，把成对联合信息与条件信息结合起来，并用部分信息分解（PID）刻画其信息结构。在五个表格数据集和 MNIST-loop 上的表现并不一致，SynAFA 只在部分情形下取得最强提升。这说明协同信息的价值高度依赖具体数据与设定，并非普遍有益。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active feature acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects informative features under budget constraints. However, existing policies rarely distinguish whether information contributed by interacting features is redundant, unique, or synergistic. We introduce SynAFA, a state-dependent AFA policy that combines pairwise joint information and conditional information, with Partial Information Decomposition (PID) characterizing its information structure. Across five tabular datasets and MNIST-loop, performance is heterogeneous. SynAFA shows its strongest ga…
items.why_zh: 该研究用信息论视角厘清了“协同信息”在特征获取中的适用边界，说明协同并非总是有益。
items.why_en: It uses an information-theoretic lens to clarify when synergy actually pays off in feature acquisition, showing the benefit is not universal.

items.title_zh: 训练数据不完整下的主动特征获取
items.title_en: Active Feature Acquisition With Incomplete Training Data
items.summary_zh: 在许多预测任务中，获取全部特征代价高昂甚至根本不可能，而固定的特征子集也难以在不同样本上都取得足够好的效果。主动特征获取（AFA）通过顺序选择特征，形式化了特征成本与预测性能之间的权衡。然而既有 AFA 工作大多假设可以获得完整的训练数据，这一假设在现实中经常被打破。本文因此研究训练数据不完整情形下的 AFA 问题（原文摘要在此处截断，具体方法未完整披露）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In many prediction tasks, acquiring all features can be a prohibitively expensive or outright impossible task. Further, in many cases a static subset of features may not be enough to solve the problem sufficiently across various instances. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses these problems by formalizing the trade-off between feature cost and predictive performance during sequential feature selection. However, prior AFA work largely assumes access to complete training data, an assumption that is often violated in practice. Here we study AF…
items.why_zh: 它把 AFA 从理想化的完整数据假设推进到更贴近现实的缺失数据场景。
items.why_en: It moves AFA beyond the idealized complete-data assumption toward more realistic missing-data settings.

items.title_zh: SoFT：面向可泛化 LLM 微调的软目标
items.title_en: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 蒸馏能让小型学生语言模型从专家教师那里获得新能力，但要把多教师、多领域的知识整合进单一学生模型仍然困难。作者研究这一设定下的监督微调（SFT），目标是在让学生获得多样能力的同时，保持对训练任务之外情形的泛化。实验显示，不同 SFT 方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间存在不同取舍，这促使研究者对训练信号施加更显式的控制，即他们提出的软目标方法 SoFT（原文摘要在此处截断，细节未完整披露）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit control over…
items.why_zh: 它为多教师蒸馏中的泛化取舍提供了一种更可控的微调信号设计。
items.why_en: It offers a more controllable fine-tuning signal for the generalization trade-offs in multi-teacher distillation.

items.title_zh: 大规模评测脑电基础模型：来自两万次评估的经验
items.title_en: Benchmarking EEG Foundation Models at Scale: Lessons from 20,000 Evaluations
items.summary_zh: 脑电（EEG）基础模型被寄望于提供可迁移的神经表征，但它们相对强监督基线的优势以及继续扩展的前景仍不清楚。为此作者推出开源基准 EEG-Arena，覆盖 30 个 EEG 基础模型与 25 个监督基线，并在来自 23 个公开数据集的 57 个下游任务上评测。团队在五种实验协议下完成了超过 20,000 次评估，考察下游性能、预训练带来的收益、模型规模扩展以及预训练方式等因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) promise transferable neural representations, yet their advantages over strong supervised baselines and their prospects for further scaling remain unclear. To address these questions, we introduce EEG-Arena, an open-source benchmark covering 30 EEG FMs and 25 supervised baselines evaluated on 57 downstream tasks from 23 public datasets. Through more than 20,000 evaluations across five experimental protocols, we assess downstream performance, pretraining benefits, model size scaling, pretraining…
items.why_zh: 它以目前规模最大的统一评测，回答了脑电基础模型是否真的优于监督基线这一问题。
items.why_en: It offers the largest unified evaluation to date of whether EEG foundation models truly beat supervised baselines.

items.title_zh: 复用还是重学？地球观测基础模型的光谱视角
items.title_en: Reuse or Relearn? A Spectral View of Earth Observation Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 基础模型很少被当作通用的冻结特征提取器使用，通常都要针对下游任务进行微调，这在地球观测（EO）领域尤为普遍。这带来一个仅凭下游精度无法回答的问题：微调究竟是在复用预训练表征，还是重新学了一套新的表征。作者用光谱诊断方法比较模型微调前后的状态，量化其主要奇异子空间被保留的程度，以及权重更新影响的范围。这为判断 EO 基础模型的迁移性质提供了新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32756v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models are rarely used as generic, frozen feature extractors; instead, they are fine-tuned for the target downstream application. This practice is particularly prevalent in Earth observation (EO), and it raises a question that downstream accuracy alone cannot answer: does fine-tuning reuse the pretrained representation, or does it relearn a new one? We study this with spectral diagnostics that compare a model before and after adaptation, quantifying how well its dominant singular subspaces are preserved, how broadly the weight update i…
items.why_zh: 它提供了超越准确率的诊断手段，用于判断微调是否真正复用了预训练知识。
items.why_en: It provides diagnostics beyond accuracy for judging whether fine-tuning truly reuses pretrained knowledge.

items.title_zh: 饱和不敏感、带通用函数逼近的对抗赌博机
items.title_en: Saturation-Insensitive Dueling Bandits with General Function Approximation
items.summary_zh: 本文研究在 Bradley-Terry-Luce（BTL）偏好模型下、采用通用函数逼近的情境对抗赌博机（contextual dueling bandits）。该设定的核心难题是偏好模型的饱和：当当前奖励模型已经能高置信度地区分两个动作时，所产生的偏好反馈信息量很弱，难以继续改进奖励估计。其结果是，既有的样本复杂度分析往往依赖反导数因子 1/σ'[Δr*]，而该因子可能大到难以接受。作者据此提出对饱和不敏感的方法来绕开这一障碍。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.33011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study contextual dueling bandits with general function approximation under the Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) preference model. A key challenge in this setting is the saturation of the preference model: when the current reward model can already distinguish two actions with high confidence, the resulting preference feedback becomes weakly informative, making it difficult to further improve reward estimation. Consequently, existing sample-complexity analyses often depend on the inverse-derivative factor $1 / \sigma'[\Delta_{r^\ast}]$ which can be proh…
items.why_zh: 它针对偏好反馈饱和这一被忽视的难题改进了对抗赌博机的理论保证。
items.why_en: It addresses the overlooked problem of preference saturation to strengthen theoretical guarantees for dueling bandits.

items.title_zh: 当评测规则写出训练标签：衡量 NAVSIM 中的人类参考宽容
items.title_en: When an Evaluation Rule Writes Training Labels: Measuring Human-Reference Forgiveness in NAVSIM
items.summary_zh: 在 NAVSIM 中，当人类参考轨迹在某个指标上得分为零时，官方发布的 GTRS-Dense 标签生成器会把该场景中所有候选轨迹都标记为该指标通过。NAVSIM 作者引入这种“人类参考宽容”，是为了在给单条轨迹打分时避免惩罚情境上合理的操作，同时也警告这可能掩盖重要失败。但在标签生成环节，这条规则会把整整一列 16,384 个候选目标全部设为通过。为了衡量其对监督信号的影响，作者在禁用该覆盖规则后重新运行生成器并进行对比。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.33189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When the human reference scores zero on a metric, the released GTRS-Dense label generator for NAVSIM marks every candidate trajectory in the scene as passing it. NAVSIM's authors introduced this human-reference forgiveness to avoid penalizing contextually justified maneuvers when scoring one trajectory, and warned that it could overlook important failures. In label generation it sets a whole column of 16,384 candidate targets to passing. To measure the consequences for supervision, we re-run the generator with the overwrite disabled and compare t…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了评测中的宽容规则可能悄然污染自动驾驶训练标签、放大监督偏差。
items.why_en: It shows how a forgiving evaluation rule can silently contaminate training labels and bias autonomous-driving supervision.

items.title_zh: SAE 特征何时可解释？面向脑电基础模型的验证阶梯
items.title_en: When Is an SAE Feature Interpretable? A Validation Ladder for EEG Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）能把稠密的模型激活分解为离散潜变量，使单个特征易于解释，也同样易于被误读。在脑电基础模型中，一个诱人的推断是：如果移除 alpha 频段活动会强烈改变某个潜变量的激活，就认为该潜变量表征 alpha 活动。作者在横跨三个骨干模型、三个 EEG 数据集和三种网络深度的 27 种设定中检验这一推断，发现它初看很有说服力——移除 alpha 使潜变量激活变化的幅度达到某对照扰动的 7.3 倍。据此他们提出一套“验证阶梯”，用于检验 SAE 特征的可解释性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense model activations into discrete latents, making individual features easy to interpret--and easy to misinterpret. In EEG foundation models, this creates a tempting inference: if removing alpha-band activity strongly changes a latent's activation, one might conclude that the latent represents alpha activity. Across 27 settings spanning three backbones, three EEG datasets, and three network depths, this interpretation initially appears compelling: alpha removal changes latent firing 7.3 times more than an e…
items.why_zh: 它为日益增多的 SAE 可解释性结论提供了必要的验证范式，防止过度解读。
items.why_en: It provides a much-needed validation framework for the growing body of SAE interpretability claims, guarding against over-interpretation.

items.title_zh: 用可训练向量揭示大模型 RLVR 的几何结构
items.title_en: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）——当前提升大语言模型推理能力的关键范式。由于参数更新的维度极高，其训练动力学一直难以分析，作者转而使用向量引导（vector steering）方法，在激活空间中识别出一个与 RL 带来的性能提升相关的低维“有效流形”。研究由此揭示了两项几何性质，其中第一项被称为“有效流形容量”：复现 RL 增益所需的容量可以非常小，但并非可以无限压缩。这一视角为理解 RL 训练如何改变模型内部表征提供了新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compress…
items.why_zh: 它把难以解读的 RL 训练动力学转化为激活空间中的几何问题，为分析和控制大模型 RL 后训练提供了新的可操作视角。
items.why_en: It reframes opaque RL training dynamics as a tractable geometry problem in activation space, offering a new way to analyze and steer LLM post-training.

items.title_zh: 面向类增量学习的分布条件任务路由
items.title_en: Distribution-Conditioned Task Routing for Class-Incremental Learning
items.summary_zh: 参数高效微调让持续学习模型能用紧凑的更新获取任务专属知识，但类增量推理要求模型在不知道输入属于哪个任务的情况下，在所有已见类别中做出判断。对于采用任务专属参数高效模块的学习器而言，这带来一个超出灾难性遗忘的关键难题：任务路由。论文研究事后（post-hoc）任务路由，即在不重新训练学习器、也不引入额外独立模块的前提下，为输入分配合适的任务模块，并提出基于分布条件的路由方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parameter-efficient adaptation enables continual learners to acquire task-specific knowledge through compact model updates while maintaining strong within-task performance. However, class-incremental inference requires each input to be classified among all classes seen so far without access to its task identity. For learners equipped with task-specific parameter-efficient modules, this introduces a critical task-routing challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting. We study post-hoc task routing without retraining the learner or introducing a separat…
items.why_zh: 任务路由是任务专属参数高效持续学习走向实用时必须跨过的门槛，该工作给出了无需重训的解决思路。
items.why_en: Task routing is the missing piece for making task-specific parameter-efficient continual learning practical, and this work offers a retraining-free solution.

items.title_zh: PMOPD：多教师在线策略蒸馏中的任务排序、循环与参数更新子空间保护
items.title_en: PMOPD: Task Ordering, Cycling, and Parameter-Update Subspace Protection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.summary_zh: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）已成为在前沿语言模型中整合多种专门能力的常用后训练范式。既有在线策略蒸馏研究多聚焦于通过目标设计、蒸馏范围与教师信号构建来优化单任务蒸馏，而 MOPD 必须在共享参数中聚合多种能力，因而面临“能力跷跷板”问题——提升某一领域会压制从另一领域获得的能力。受更新模式的启发，作者提出 PMOPD，从任务排序、任务循环以及参数更新子空间保护三个方面缓解该冲突。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) has emerged as a popular post-training paradigm for integrating specialized capabilities in frontier language models. Existing OPD research has primarily focused on optimizing single-task distillation through objective design, distillation scope, and teacher signal construction, whereas MOPD must aggregate multiple capabilities in shared parameters and address the resulting capability seesaw, in which improving one domain suppresses capabilities acquired from another. Inspired by the distinctive update…
items.why_zh: “能力跷跷板”是合并多个专家模型时的核心痛点，该工作给出了可操作的训练调度与参数保护方案。
items.why_en: The capability seesaw is a core obstacle to merging multiple expert models, and this work offers a practical training-schedule and parameter-protection recipe.

items.title_zh: 面向可变带宽下鲁棒多智能体通信的注意力分层变分信息瓶颈
items.title_en: Attention-based Hierarchical Variational Information Bottleneck for Robust Multi-Agent Communication under Variable Bandwidth
items.summary_zh: 在带宽受限的条件下，基于学习的多智能体通信不仅要决定“传什么”，还要让消息结构本身具备抗截断能力，使部分传输仍然有用。论文研究前缀截断场景，即接收方只能收到每条消息的前一部分。为此作者提出 AH-VIB：一种基于注意力的自回归变分通信模型，将变分信息瓶颈（VIB）与序列化消息生成、分层鲁棒性损失相结合，从而在带宽变化时保持通信有效性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning-based multi-agent communication under limited bandwidth does not only require deciding what to communicate, but also structuring messages so that partial transmissions remain useful. We study this problem under prefix truncation, where only the first part of each message is received. To address it, we propose \textbf{AH-VIB}, an attention-based autoregressive variational communication model that combines a variational information bottleneck (VIB) with sequential message generation and a hierarchical robustness loss. We evaluate AH-VIB on…
items.why_zh: 现实中带宽波动与消息截断难以避免，让部分消息仍然可用对多智能体系统的鲁棒性至关重要。
items.why_en: Bandwidth fluctuation and message truncation are unavoidable in practice, so keeping partial messages useful is key to robust multi-agent systems.

items.title_zh: E3J：面向 GPU 与 TPU 的高效开源欧几里得等变算子后端
items.title_en: E3J: An Efficient and Open-Source Backend for Euclidean Equivariant Operations on GPU and TPU
items.summary_zh: 作者发布 e3j，一个用于几何深度学习的高效欧几里得等变性后端，提供面向 GPU 与 TPU 的 JAX 绑定。该库结合优化的 CUDA 与 Pallas 内核以及算法层面的改进，在前向与反向计算上都取得了领先的吞吐与运行时间。在机器学习原子间势（MLIP）用例中，使用 MACE 进行水盒子 NPT 模拟时，它相比 cuEquivariance 最高提速 34%，且完全开源，并实现超过 80% 的效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present e3j, a fast Euclid-equivariance backend for geometric deep learning applications with JAX bindings for GPU and TPU. Leveraging both optimized CUDA and Pallas kernels and algorithmic improvements, the library achieves state-of-the-art throughput and runtime on both forward and backward paths. On a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) use case, it outperforms established backends, measuring up to 34% speed-up over cuEquivariance on water box NPT simulation using MACE, while remaining fully open source. E3j achieves over 80% effi…
items.why_zh: 等变算子是几何深度学习与机器学习势模型的性能瓶颈，一个开源且跨 GPU/TPU 的高效后端可显著降低使用门槛。
items.why_en: Equivariant operators bottleneck geometric deep learning and ML potentials, so an efficient open-source backend spanning GPU and TPU lowers the barrier to adoption.

items.title_zh: eval-unlearn：为文生图扩散模型的概念遗忘建立统一评测基准
items.title_en: eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
items.summary_zh: 随着文生图（T2I）扩散模型的概念遗忘技术不断增多，评测环境却各自为政，实验条件不统一，导致方法之间难以进行有原则的横向比较。为此作者提出 eval-unlearn：一个开源 Python 库，为 T2I 扩散模型的概念遗忘提供统一、可复现的基准评测框架。该库整合了十二种已发表遗忘技术，涵盖微调、闭式模型编辑以及推理时干预等不同类别。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time int…
items.why_zh: 统一的评测基准是判断各类遗忘方法是否真正有效、彼此可比的前提。
items.why_en: A unified benchmark is a prerequisite for judging whether unlearning methods are genuinely effective and comparable.

items.title_zh: 用大语言模型自动识别跨领域机器学习任务类型：基准数据集与评估
items.title_en: Large Language Models for Automated Cross-Domain Machine Learning Task Type Identification: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 机器学习任务类型的识别对构建有效的 ML 流水线至关重要，但实践中通常仍需人工指定。论文研究大语言模型（LLM）能否在用户仅提供目标特征的情况下，仅凭数据集层面的信息同时推断数据领域与下游预测任务。作者随系统一同发布了包含 625 个公开表格与时序数据集的标注基准，并在表格数据等多个设定下进行评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning task type identification is essential for constructing valid ML pipelines, yet in practice it is typically specified manually. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can infer both the data domain and the downstream prediction task directly from dataset-level information when only the target feature is provided by the user. Together with our LLM-based system we also release an annotated benchmark comprising 625 public tabular and time series datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach in three settings: (i) tabular d…
items.why_zh: 自动判定任务类型可减少机器学习流水线构建中的人工环节与出错风险。
items.why_en: Automating task type identification removes a manual, error-prone step in building machine learning pipelines.

items.title_zh: SOLO：用共享输出局部学习预训练十亿参数语言模型
items.title_en: SOLO: Pretraining Billion-Parameter Language Models with Shared-Output Local Learning
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型通常依赖反向传播训练，全局梯度虽然协调所有层，却迫使每层保留激活值并等待梯度逐层回传，形成更新锁定。传统的局部学习通过让每个模块经由自己的读出层预测目标来解除这种锁定，但一直未能扩展到十亿参数级的预训练。作者指出私有读出层是关键弱点——它使各模块无法获得来自更深层模块的信息；为此提出共享输出局部学习（SOLO），将局部学习成功推向十亿参数规模的预训练。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are trained with backpropagation, whose global gradient coordinates all layers but forces each to hold its activations and wait for the gradient to pass back through every deeper layer. Conventional local learning removes this update locking by training each module to predict the target through its own readout, but has not scaled to billion-parameter pretraining. We identify these private readouts as a key weakness, since they leave each module without information from deeper modules. We propose Shared-Output LOcal learning…
items.why_zh: 若局部学习能在十亿参数规模上奏效，将有望打破反向传播带来的显存与流水线并行瓶颈。
items.why_en: If local learning works at billion-parameter scale, it could relieve the memory and pipeline-parallelism bottlenecks imposed by backpropagation.

items.title_zh: 蒸馏防御在强化学习微调后轻易失效
items.title_en: Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出，针对大模型“蒸馏攻击”的现有防御存在评估盲区：攻击者通过大量收集闭源前沿模型的推理轨迹来训练自己的模型，从而低成本复制其推理能力，而现有防御通常只在蒸馏完成的那一刻进行评估，隐含假设攻击者不会再继续训练模型。作者提出一个更贴近现实的威胁模型，认为攻击者会在蒸馏之后继续用强化学习等方式优化模型。实验表明，经过这类后续训练，原本有效的蒸馏防御很容易被攻破，说明防御评估不能只看蒸馏结束后的即时效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distillation attacks copy the reasoning capabilities of closed-source large language models, allowing bad actors to replicate state-of-the-art performance at low cost. Attackers systematically collect a large volume of frontier model reasoning traces and then train (i.e., "distill") their own models on these traces. Existing defenses against distillation attacks are typically evaluated immediately after distillation, implicitly assuming attackers do not train their models any further. In this paper, we argue that a more realistic threat model inc…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了大模型防蒸馏研究中的评估盲点：把防御效果当成一次性的静态结果，可能高估了实际保护能力。
items.why_en: It exposes an evaluation blind spot in anti-distillation research: treating defense efficacy as a one-off static result may overstate real-world protection.

items.title_zh: ScAn-Bench：系统评估缩放规律分析方法论
items.title_en: ScAn-Bench: Evaluating Scaling Analysis Methodology
items.summary_zh: 当前机器学习的进展高度依赖大规模基础模型，而缩放规律以及针对架构、数据和超参数寻找最优缩放方案，是推动前沿性能的关键。但作者指出，目前竟没有系统性研究去评估“如何得到缩放规律与缩放方案”这一方法论本身在不同模型类型上的表现。为填补这一空白，他们提出了代理基准 ScAn-Bench-LLM 和 ScAn-Bench-VLM，分别基于 4524 与 8024 个检查点构建，以支持对缩放分析方法的可复现比较与后续研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35707v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent progress in machine learning is driven by large-scale foundation models, where scaling laws and finding optimal scaling prescriptions for architecture, data, and hyperparameters are key in advancing the state-of-the-art. Therefore, it is surprising that no systematic study evaluates the methodology to obtain scaling laws and prescriptions across different model types. To shed light on this crucial blind spot and facilitate future research, we introduce the surrogate benchmarks ScAn-Bench-LLM and ScAn-Bench-VLM based on 4524 and 8024 checkp…
items.why_zh: 它为“如何做缩放分析”这一常被默认正确的前置环节提供了首个系统性评测工具。
items.why_en: It offers the first systematic benchmark for the often-taken-for-granted step of how scaling analyses are actually conducted.

items.title_zh: 基于离散扩散先验与侧信息的主动数据采集
items.title_en: Active Data Acquisition with Side Information via Discrete Diffusion Priors
items.summary_zh: 数据采集代价高昂：提高测量精度会消耗更多功耗与存储，还可能采到无关内容，而过度压缩成本又会丢掉后续分析所需的信息。作者提出一个信息论框架，不以服务单一模型为目标，而是采集对一系列任务都有用的数据。具体做法是用一个以侧信息为条件的掩码策略来决定测量哪些像素，在给定预算下最大化离散图像与其部分观测之间的互信息。由于图像先验来自离散扩散模型，该方法能在有限的测量预算内更高效地保留有用信息。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32252v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Acquiring data is costly: higher measurement fidelity costs power and storage and risks collecting irrelevant content, while aggressive cost reduction can discard information that later analysis needs. We address this trade-off with an information-theoretic framework that acquires data relevant to a broad set of tasks rather than to one model. A mask policy, conditioned on side information, chooses which pixels to measure so as to maximize the mutual information between a discrete image and its partial observation under a budget; since the imag…
items.why_zh: 它把“采哪些数据”变成可优化的信息论决策，有望降低感知与存储成本而不牺牲下游分析价值。
items.why_en: It turns which data to acquire into an optimizable information-theoretic decision, potentially cutting sensing and storage costs without sacrificing downstream analysis.

items.title_zh: 基于极分解的 GPU 快速可微 SVD
items.title_en: Fast Differentiable SVD on GPU via Polar Decomposition
items.summary_zh: 作者提出一套完全面向 GPU 的 SVD 流水线，其核心是极分解，动机来自牛顿-舒尔茨迭代等只依赖矩阵乘法的迭代方法。该方案相比标准实现最高可取得约 2 倍加速。此外，他们为极分解推导了数值稳定的反向传播过程，并借此得到完全可微的 SVD。相关方法已在 PyTorch 和 JAX 中以开源实现发布（https://github.com/fallnlove/cans_svd）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32505v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a fully GPU-oriented SVD pipeline based on polar decomposition, motivated by iterative methods that rely solely on matrix multiplications, such as the Newton-Schulz iteration. We show that this approach enables up to a $2\times$ speedup compared to standard implementations. Furthermore, we derive a numerically stable backward pass for the polar decomposition and leverage it to obtain a fully differentiable SVD. Our methods are released as open-source implementations in both PyTorch and JAX: https://github.com/fallnlove/cans_svd.
items.why_zh: 它将 SVD 的训练友好性与 GPU 上的高效计算结合起来，可加速依赖该分解的大规模模型训练与数值计算。
items.why_en: It combines training-friendly differentiability with GPU efficiency, speeding up large-scale training and numerical workloads that rely on SVD.

items.title_zh: 学会评估什么：多目标贝叶斯优化中的相关性感知解耦
items.title_en: Learning What to Evaluate: Correlation-Aware Decoupling for Multiobjective Bayesian Optimization
items.summary_zh: 使用高斯过程代理模型的多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）是求解多目标问题的高样本效率方法，其中贝叶斯决策论式的采集函数会自适应地选择新候选输入，评估目标与约束后逐步更新代理模型。现有方法通常为各目标与约束分别维护独立的高斯过程，但每次新观测都会以耦合方式同时评估所有目标与约束，可能造成不必要的评估开销。该工作提出相关性感知的解耦思路，让优化过程学习“该评估什么”，从而在保持效果的同时减少评估成本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32632v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multiobjective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) with Gaussian process (GP) surrogates is a sample efficient approach to solving multiobjective optimization problems. In MOBO, a Bayesian decision theoretic acquisition function guides the adaptive selection of new candidate inputs, on which objectives and constraints are evaluated to update the surrogate model sequentially. Existing approaches maintain independent GP models for the objectives and constraints, with new observations evaluating all objectives and constraints in a coupled fashion. Howeve…
items.why_zh: 它通过解耦评估来降低多目标优化中昂贵的实验或仿真开销，直接提升样本效率。
items.why_en: By decoupling evaluations, it cuts the cost of expensive experiments or simulations and directly improves sample efficiency in multiobjective optimization.

items.title_zh: Copper-Policy：关注表征以实现鲁棒的机器人操作
items.title_en: Copper-Policy: Focus on the Representation for Robust Robot Manipulation
items.summary_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）通过建模未来场景演化来获得行为先验，但在像素或潜空间中预测细粒度未来代价高昂。近期有证据显示，即使不在测试时做生成，协同训练带来的收益依然存在，这引出一个问题：WAM 究竟需要学到什么才能改善控制？作者提出 Copper-Policy，它随策略一起学习紧凑的世界表征，而不依赖预先定义的目标空间；通过时序联合嵌入预测，在给定动作条件下预测未来观测的嵌入表示，以支撑更鲁棒的机器人操作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) acquire behavioral priors by modeling future scene evolution, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space incurs substantial cost. Recent evidence that co-training gains persist without test-time generation raises a question: what must a WAM learn to improve control? We introduce Copper-Policy, which learns a compact World representation with the policy rather than relying on a predefined target space. Through temporal joint-embedding prediction, it predicts future observation embeddings conditioned on ta…
items.why_zh: 它提出用紧凑世界表征替代昂贵的未来生成，为机器人策略学习指明更省算力的方向。
items.why_en: It replaces costly future generation with a compact world representation, pointing to a more compute-efficient route for robot policy learning.

items.title_zh: RAGWarrant：在质量、成本、延迟与风险约束下守护 RAG 策略上线
items.title_en: RAGWarrant: Evidence-Preserving Governance for RAG Policy Promotion Under Quality, Cost, Latency, and Risk Constraints
items.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统普遍配备了指标、基准、链路追踪和自动评审等工具，但这些工具并不能判断一项策略变更是否可以安全发布。作者提出 RAGWarrant，一个开源的“上线管控”框架，把部署视为受约束的证据决策，而非排行榜上的择优。该框架统一归一化评测器输出与运行遥测数据，施加预先声明的质量门与硬性风险门，为不同证据等级的结论设定可信上限，并保留负面结果记录，从而在质量、成本、延迟与风险之间做出可审计的发布决策。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.34179v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are extensively instrumented with metrics, benchmarks, traces, and automated judges, but these tools do not decide whether a proposed policy change is safe to release. We present RAGWarrant, an open-source promotion-control framework that treats deployment as a constrained evidence decision rather than a leaderboard choice. RAGWarrant normalizes evaluator outputs and operational telemetry, applies predeclared quality and hard-risk gates, assigns evidence-class claim ceilings, preserves negative outcomes, a…
items.why_zh: 它把 RAG 的发布决策从“看排行榜”变成可审计、受约束的证据流程，降低上线风险。
items.why_en: It turns RAG release decisions from leaderboard choices into auditable, constraint-based evidence processes, lowering deployment risk.

items.title_zh: Sol-H3：面向 MiniMax-H3 推理加速的递归自我改进，覆盖云与边缘
items.title_en: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge
items.summary_zh: 视频扩散模型规模迅速扩大、生成能力不断增强，其中 MiniMax-H3 是颇具代表性的生产级开源模型。但其 330 亿参数与多步迭代去噪带来巨大计算开销：在 NVIDIA GB200 等云端部署中生成延迟高，在 DGX Spark 等边缘设备上还面临严格的内存限制，实际生产受阻。为此，作者提出 Sol-H3，利用递归自我改进的思路，在 Sol-Engine 上对 MiniMax-H3 的推理进行加速，以同时应对云端延迟与边缘内存两方面的约束。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35110v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To addres…
items.why_zh: 它直面大型视频扩散模型在云端延迟与边缘内存上的双重瓶颈，关系到此类模型能否真正落地生产。
items.why_en: It tackles the twin bottlenecks of cloud latency and edge memory for large video diffusion models, which determines whether they can be deployed in production.

items.title_zh: 少一点谄媚，拒绝更坚定？机制可解释性给 AI 安全的启示
items.title_en: Less Sycophancy, Stronger Refusal? Lessons for AI Safety from Mechanistic Interpretability
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文提出疑问：减少语言模型的“谄媚”倾向，是否能让它更坚定地拒绝有害请求。作者采用“补偿性特征注入”（CFI）这一训练技术，在学习过程中向模型提供目标概念的激活，以限制该概念的习得。实验在三个 Qwen3.5 基础模型上展开，试图验证降低谄媚能否在安全训练所覆盖的有害场景之外带来更强的拒绝能力。研究希望从机制可解释性中提炼对 AI 安全的启示。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35544v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reliable refusal of harmful requests is essential to the safe deployment of language models. Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we us…
items.why_zh: 若能通过降低谄媚提升拒绝能力，就为超出安全训练场景的对齐提供了一条可解释的新路径。
items.why_en: If less sycophancy yields stronger refusal, it offers an interpretability-grounded route to alignment beyond safety-training scenarios.

items.title_zh: WirelessMathBench-XL：可审计的无线数学推理基准
items.title_en: WirelessMathBench-XL: An Auditable Benchmark for Wireless Mathematical Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 研究团队提出 WirelessMathBench-XL，一个面向无线领域的可审计数学推理基准。由于从 arXiv 论文构建的技术领域基准可能与 LLM 预训练所用的公开文本重叠，作者设计了固定 13-gram 阈值的“反向探测”审计：索引基准提示、流式扫描公开预训练语料，并输出每道题的提示表层词汇重叠元数据。该方案的内存占用随基准规模而非语料规模增长，使用者可以自行检查并复算证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.23219v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Technical-domain benchmarks constructed from arXiv papers can overlap the same public text used in LLM pretraining. Auditing this risk at training-corpus scale requires searching billions of corpus n-grams while retaining per-item evidence that users can inspect and recompute. We contribute a reverse-probe audit at a fixed 13-gram threshold: it indexes benchmark prompts, streams public pretraining corpora, and emits per-problem prompt-surface lexical-overlap metadata with memory that scales with the benchmark. We instantiate the protocol in W…
items.why_zh: 它为技术领域基准提供了可复核的数据污染审计手段，有助于提升评测结果的可信度。
items.why_en: It provides a recomputable contamination audit, strengthening trust in technical-domain benchmark results.

items.title_zh: 为遗忘而设计的模型：通过键删除实现机器遗忘
items.title_en: Models Designed to Forget: Machine Unlearning via Key Deletion
items.summary_zh: 在隐私法规、数据错误以及移除有害或损坏训练图像的共同推动下，视觉模型的机器遗忘正迅速成为现实需求。作者指出，现有大多数近似遗忘方法都采取“事后补救”视角，通过参数更新抹去目标样本的影响，而且通常需要访问完整的训练数据。这与真实部署场景存在错配——在实际系统中，遗忘请求往往是可以提前预见的。论文据此提出基于“键删除”的遗忘思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.15033v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine unlearning for vision models is rapidly becoming a practical requirement, driven by privacy regulations, data errors, and the need to remove harmful or corrupted training images. Despite this, most existing approximate unlearning methods tackle the problem from a post-hoc perspective. They attempt to erase the influence of targeted samples through parameter updates that typically require access to the full training data. This creates a mismatch with real deployment scenarios where unlearning requests can be anticipated, revealing a fu…
items.why_zh: 它把遗忘从“事后补救”前移到模型设计阶段，更贴合真实部署中的合规需求。
items.why_en: It moves unlearning from post-hoc patching into model design, better matching real-world compliance needs.

items.title_zh: 对比很关键：上下文微调对目标—上下文相关性的鲁棒性
items.title_en: Contrast Matters: Understanding Robustness of In-Context Fine-Tuning to Target-Context Relatedness
items.summary_zh: 上下文微调（IC-Train）指在上下文中提供带标签示例来训练 LLM，正越来越多地取代标准微调，用于领域适配和持续吸收标注数据。研究关注这种训练所涌现的上下文学习能力的鲁棒性：当测试输入的上下文示例从毫不相关到几乎相同，微调后的模型表现是否依然稳定。实验覆盖 32 种配置，涉及四个开源 LLM 与八个测试集，任务包括机器翻译、Text-to-SQL 和多语言场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.01601v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In-context fine-tuning (IC-Train), training an LLM with labeled examples in-context, is increasingly used in place of standard fine-tuning for domain adaptation and continual absorption of labeled data. We study the robustness of the in-context learning ability that emerges from such training: does the fine-tuned model perform well across test inputs whose in-context examples range from unrelated to nearly identical? Across 32 configurations spanning four open-source LLMs and eight test sets over machine translation, Text-to-SQL, and multilin…
items.why_zh: 上下文微调正被广泛用于领域适配，弄清其对示例相关性的敏感度决定了它能否被放心替代标准微调。
items.why_en: As in-context fine-tuning spreads for domain adaptation, knowing its sensitivity to example relatedness determines whether it can safely replace standard fine-tuning.

items.title_zh: 费率厘定中的合成数据：插补方法对比对抗网络与自编码器
items.title_en: Synthetic data for ratemaking: imputation-based methods vs adversarial networks and autoencoders
items.summary_zh: 精算费率厘定依赖高质量数据，但获取新数据成本高昂、且受隐私顾虑等限制。本文探索以合成数据生成作为潜在解决方案：除精算文献中已经研究过的生成方法外，作者还引入并基准测试了基于链式方程多元插补（MICE）的另一类方法。研究使用开源数据集开展对比实验，将基于 MICE 的模型与其他生成方法（如对抗网络和自编码器）进行评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.02171v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Actuarial ratemaking depends on high-quality data, yet access to such data is often limited by the cost of obtaining new data, privacy concerns, etc. In this paper, we explore synthetic-data generation as a potential solution to these issues. In addition to generative methods previously studied in the actuarial literature, we explore and benchmark another class of approaches based on Multivariate Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE). In a comparative study using an open-source dataset, MICE-based models are evaluated against other gen…
items.why_zh: 它为数据受限的保险精算提供了可替代的合成数据方案，并给出方法间的实证对比。
items.why_en: It offers alternative synthetic-data routes for data-constrained actuarial work, with empirical comparisons among methods.

items.title_zh: 人类何时该介入？AI 辅助决策中的最优人工调度
items.title_en: When Should Humans Step In? Optimal Human Dispatching in AI-Assisted Decisions
items.summary_zh: AI 系统越来越多地通过给出低成本的“因子级”评估来辅助复杂决策，但这些评估可能带有偏差或并不完整。论文研究“选择性人工评估”问题：在已有 AI 信号的前提下，哪些因子应当被派发给人类专家判断。作者将这种人机协作形式化为因子级的信息获取问题。在平方损失下，最优调度规则最大化一个与上下文相关的收益；在线性模型下，该收益可分解为两个可解释的闭式项。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.13688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: AI systems increasingly assist decision making by producing cheap factor-level assessments of complex inputs, but these assessments can be biased or incomplete. We study selective human evaluation: given AI signals, which factors should be dispatched to human experts? We formulate this human--AI collaboration problem as a factor-level information-acquisition problem. Under squared loss, the optimal dispatching rule maximizes a contextual reward; under a linear model, this reward admits a closed-form decomposition into two interpretable…
items.why_zh: 它给出了“哪里该由人接手”的可计算规则，有助于在有限专家资源下提升人机协作决策质量。
items.why_en: It yields a computable rule for when humans should take over, helping allocate scarce expert attention in human-AI decisions.

items.title_zh: 非平稳广义线性赌博机与折扣在线镜像下降
items.title_en: Nonstationary Generalized Linear Bandits with Discounted Online Mirror Descent
items.summary_zh: 论文研究非平稳广义线性赌博机（GLB）：期望收益通过非线性链接函数建模，其参数未知且随时间变化。该框架涵盖线性、伯努利和二项等多种收益模型。现有方法大多基于最大似然估计（MLE），借助滑动窗口、重启或折扣机制来应对非平稳性；它们虽能取得统计上高效的遗憾保证，但一般还有额外要求。作者转而提出基于折扣在线镜像下降的方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.25590v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study nonstationary generalized linear bandits (GLBs), where the expected reward is modeled through a nonlinear link function with an unknown time-varying parameter. This framework encompasses a broad class of reward models, including linear, Bernoulli, and binomial rewards. Existing approaches are predominantly based on maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE), using sliding-window, restart, or discounting mechanisms to handle nonstationarity. Although these methods achieve statistically efficient regret guarantees, they generally requir…
items.why_zh: 它把在线镜像下降引入非平稳广义线性赌博机，为动态环境下的决策提供了新的算法思路。
items.why_en: It brings online mirror descent to nonstationary generalized linear bandits, offering a new algorithmic angle for decision-making in changing environments.

items.summary_en: According to Sohu, DeepSeek has open-sourced an "AI toolbox" for Huawei's Ascend platform, spanning components from TileLang to communication libraries. The release is presented as another step forward for China's domestic compute ecosystem.

items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao has officially launched a one-stop travel service, letting users handle travel-related needs directly within the app. The move extends the assistant beyond Q&A and content generation into real-world service scenarios. Details on covered services and partners were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: AI 助手正从“聊天工具”转向可直接完成交易与服务的入口，出行是高频率、高价值的落地场景。
items.why_en: AI assistants are shifting from chat tools into transactional service gateways, and travel is a high-frequency, high-value use case.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek正式开源华为昇腾算力基础设施组件，与英伟达平台相对应 article.pchome.net

The move signals dual-track support for both Ascend and NVIDIA hardware stacks. It lowers the barrier for Chinese developers running DeepSeek models on domestic chips.
items.why_zh: 头部模型厂商公开适配国产算力，有助于削弱对英伟达生态的单点依赖。
items.why_en: A leading model maker openly supporting domestic Chinese silicon helps reduce dependence on NVIDIA's ecosystem.

items.title_en: DeepSeek Harness Desktop Preview; OpenAI to Restore $200 Pro Plan With Halved Usage
